headline: Casa VO / Desangles Abreu Arquitectos & Arkina
context: On a steep piece of family land in the mountains of Jarabacoa , Casa VO combines steel, dark wood, and earth-toned plaster in a weekend retreat that opens end to end, from the forest to the valley.
